about.heading: About
about.title: Dataverse Docent v{version}
about.blurb: Desktop assistant for curating Dataverse datasets: discover drafts, approve downloads, run format checks, verify metadata, compare versions, and record decisions — all against the Dataverse Native/Search API with an API token. No direct database access; downloads, reports, and metadata caches live under your workspace.
about.bullets:
• Dashboard of datasets in review with status, label, and collection filters
• Per-file format checks (20 engines) plus dataset-level findings
• Metadata check profiles and published-vs-draft comparison
• Per-dataset timeline: versions, curation labels, local actions
• Headless mode: python main.py --headless <dir>
